## Question

What decision will this research inform?

## Scope

Which categories / candidates are in scope?

## Evidence standards

- [ ] Prefer official/primary sources (project docs, original educational sources)
- [ ] No SEO summaries as primary evidence when original sources exist
- [ ] Licenses verified at the source, not assumed
- [ ] Free-to-access vs free-to-redistribute distinguished

## Per-candidate evaluation

For each candidate considered:

```text
What does it solve?
License?
Free?
Open-source?
Maintained?
Quality?
Integration effort?
Lock-in?
Do we actually need it?
```

## Deliverable

Written findings + recommendation. No implementation as part of the research
issue unless explicitly scoped.
